testPlan.title: Panels on top of each other + help text

test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: Smooth card under its help page
test.hint: Press 7 (Smooth), then / for help. Drag the Smooth card so half of it is under the help page. The help page reads clean: no card text or buttons show on it. PASS if so.

test.title: The help page takes the clicks
test.hint: Click and roll the wheel on the help page, right over where the card sits under it. The help scrolls; nothing on the card changes. PASS if so.

test.title: Card on top of the main panel
test.hint: Close help (/). Drag the Smooth card over the main panel. The card reads clean: no panel text shows through it, and its buttons work. Drag it back. PASS if so.

test.title: Warning box on top of the card
test.hint: With Smooth, click a point on one road, then a point on a road not joined to it. A red box says they are not connected. It reads clean over the card. Click it: it closes. PASS if so.

test.title: Select popup on top of the help page
test.hint: Pick Select. Press / for help. Click a point: its popup opens. Drag the popup by its title onto the help page. The popup reads clean, its buttons work, and the wheel on it does not scroll the help. PASS if so.

test.title: This test card on top of the help page
test.hint: With help open, drag the main panel to the right edge. The help page slides under this card. This card reads clean, and its buttons still work. Drag the panel back. PASS if so.

test.title: Manual and settings show alone
test.hint: On the help page click browse the full manual: only the manual shows. Close it. Click the gear: only the settings page shows. Close it. PASS if so.

test.title: Every tool's help reads clean
test.hint: Help open. Press 1 to 9 and 0 in turn. Each help page reads clean, with no card text on it. PASS if so.

test.title: Delete says right-click deletes a selection
test.hint: Pick Delete. Alt+drag a box round a few points. The NEXT line says right-click deletes them and Esc clears. Press Esc. PASS if so.

test.title: Straighten tolerance shows two decimals
test.hint: Press 8 (Straighten). Step the tolerance with + once. It reads 0.25 m style values, not 0.3 m. PASS if so.

test.title: Help pages say what the tools do
test.hint: Read help for Field loop (3), Merge and Ground. Field loop: click inside a field. Merge: the other track is folded in. Ground: points more than the tolerance off move. PASS if they read right.
